app.name: Chroma subsampling test
app.long_description: Test patterns for the YUV 4:2:2 video bus. D-pad left/right switches resolution (240p/480i/480p standard, and 240p/480i with every pixel doubled horizontally to 1280 wide). D-pad up/down switches pattern. HOME or START exits. The doubled modes put each source pixel on its own 4:2:2 pair, so an FPGA can reconstruct 4:4:4.
